purpose: Legal, authoritative and freely accessible material anchors for UPSC CSE 2027 preparation. Copyrighted commercial books are not copied into this repository; user-supplied legitimate copies belong in the ChatGPT Project knowledge library.

syllabus.note: The repository taxonomy is the operational index. The applicable CSE 2027 notification/syllabus supersedes this historical notification when officially published.

materials.name: NCERT Textbooks
materials.use: School-level conceptual foundations for History, Geography, Society, Economy, Science and Environment.

materials.name: IGNOU eGyanKosh
materials.use: Open educational material for selected GS and Economics topics.

materials.name: Union Budget
materials.use: Budget documents, Finance Bill, fiscal policy and expenditure/revenue data.

materials.name: Economic Survey
materials.use: Macroeconomic, sectoral and policy evidence for GS-III and Economics Optional.

materials.name: Reserve Bank of India
materials.use: Monetary policy, banking, financial system, statistics and reports.

materials.name: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
materials.use: Official statistics, national accounts, surveys and indicators.

materials.name: NITI Aayog
materials.use: Policy reports, development indicators and government strategy.

materials.name: Parliament of India
materials.use: Bills, parliamentary material, committees and legislative information.

materials.name: India Code
materials.use: Central Acts, subordinate legislation and legal text.

materials.name: UPSC Previous Question Papers Archives
